review:
Ding Dong Death is a 6x3 avalanche slot with a five-level Death Meter. Every third avalanche unlocks a level, which turns all of a chosen character symbol into something better. xNudge Wilds drop to the bottom of their reel and gain +1 for every symbol they pass.

If three or more matching symbols line up horizontally without a win, Knock Knock is triggered. xSplit also appears, and the bonus is Ding Dong Spins. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 14,280x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
